reconstructed_captions.9: He stops walking and approaches a large birch tree.
reconstructed_captions.10: He sets his bag down in the snow at the base of the tree.
reconstructed_captions.11: He leans his axe against the birch tree.
reconstructed_captions.12: He examines the bark of the tree, looking for a piece to use.
reconstructed_captions.13: He uses his gloved fingers to get a grip on a loose piece of bark.
reconstructed_captions.14: He pulls at the edge of the birch bark to begin peeling it off.
